        WithLp.toLp 2
            (baseCoordinate n x,

repairs.evidence: The v44 original simpa normalized the sequence but exposed a limit mismatch between the nested WithLp coordinate reconstruction and the ambient subtype coercion. The v45 goal-side change converted that mismatch into a definitional-equality failure. The replacement proves the missing endpoint equality extensionally with the same two-level WithLp.ofLp_injective plus Prod.ext pattern already used elsewhere in the authority source, rewrites only the endpoint, then reuses the original exact function normalization.
